description: Delivered audit disclosures of confidential ring transfers, one case per layout: dense, exits, escrow and exits_escrow at capacity 8, pair_exits at capacity 2 and quad_escrow at capacity 4. Hex strings are big-endian, fields 32 bytes. Domain tags are ASCII as one field: CRBS, CRDS, CROD, TXOB, TXOS. Fixed inputs: tx_viewing_sk is the clamped X25519 transaction secret and tx_viewing_u its public key, salt, first_nullifier n0, ring_id = hash_bytes(ring_program_id), blinding_seed = Poseidon(CRBS, pack_be(tx_viewing_sk), salt), seed_out = Poseidon(TXOS, n0, blinding_seed), output_tree_id. layout is the audit statement's flag value exits | key_escrow << 1 | full_openings << 3, read from the ring frame, the auditor takes the disclosure layout from that frame and the published output count. Per slot: owner_key is a raw Solana key whose owner identity is hash_bytes(0x53 || owner_key), nullifier_pk, asset = hash_bytes(asset_address), amount, data_hash, ring_data_hash, owner_tag is the published owner tag (the recipient u of a ring output, the owner key of an exit, random bytes on a dummy). Every slot has blinding = Poseidon(TXOB, n0, seed_out, i). output_hash is the SPP UTXO hash under output_tree_id, owner Poseidon(owner identity, nullifier_pk), ring id ring_id on a ring output and 0 on an exit, a dummy hashes under the dummy domain with zero fields. A ring output has slot_secret = Poseidon(CRDS, pack_be(X25519(tx_viewing_sk, recipient_u)), pack_be(0x04 || tx_viewing_u), pack_be(0x04 || recipient_u), salt, i, n0) and body = AES-256-CTR(blinding || u64be(amount)) under the audit stream key and nonce of slot_secret (info CRING/adt1), its data hashes zero. The body names no asset, the auditor takes the held asset whose hash_bytes(asset_address) rebuilds output_hash. The owner tag of a ring output is its recipient_u, a dummy's owner tag and body are random. plaintext: seed_out first when an output exits, then the nullifier_pk of every slot (0 on a dummy) unless key_escrow, then pack_disclosure of every slot, 40 bytes each when an output exits (a ring output owner_key || 0^8, an exit asset || u64be(amount), a dummy zeros), 32 bytes otherwise (a ring output owner_key, a dummy zeros). Under key_escrow the auditor takes each owner's nullifier_pk from its escrow record. pack_disclosure cuts bytes into 31-byte chunks, each behind one zero byte, the last chunk zero padded at its end. pad[j] = Poseidon(Poseidon(CROD, pack_be(tx_viewing_sk), salt), j), published[j] = (plaintext[j] + pad[j]) mod q, disclosure_chain = HashChain4(published). Generated by sdk-libs/client/tests/disclosure_vectors.rs.
